ASRInputEvidence.title: ASRInputEvidence

ASRUncertainSegment.description: A non-authoritative ASR alternative that must never become stored user text.
ASRUncertainSegment.title: ASRUncertainSegment

ActivityPromptContext.description: Server-resolved activity state; clients may send only its session id.
ActivityPromptContext.title: ActivityPromptContext

ApiConfig.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint configuration kept outside prompt text.
ApiConfig.title: ApiConfig

ChatTurnCreateRequest.description:
Public chat input with server-resolved fields hidden from OpenAPI.

The hidden fields remain typed compatibility inputs so older clients keep
their existing validation and idempotency behavior. ConversationService
still replaces every one of them with authoritative server state.
ChatTurnCreateRequest.title: ChatTurnCreateRequest

InputEvidence.description: Transport-only evidence. It is intentionally excluded from durable user content.
InputEvidence.title: InputEvidence

ProviderHttpAttempt.description: One real HTTP request issued to an LLM provider.
ProviderHttpAttempt.title: ProviderHttpAttempt

ScenePromptContext.description: Server-resolved visual scene for the current conversation.
ScenePromptContext.title: ScenePromptContext

VoiceDeliveryState.description: Ephemeral voice-only evidence about what audio likely reached the user.
VoiceDeliveryState.title: VoiceDeliveryState

VoiceInteractionContext.description:
User-selected presentation context for one live voice session.

The scene is transport-only context. It may shape the current response, but
it is never authoritative profile evidence and must not become durable
conversation history by itself.
VoiceInteractionContext.title: VoiceInteractionContext
